value.rationale: For a natural two-color local-diversity objective on an infinite class of social graphs, determines every exact equilibrium type-population coefficient, characterizes all and only profitable swaps even when arbitrary destinations are allowed, and establishes a sharp strictly decreasing edge-interface potential and exponential equilibrium sparsity. These are motivated game properties not just a named sequence.
